name: rust-api-design
title_zh: 按 Rust API Guidelines 逐条审你
tagline_zh: 写完库最怕发布后才发现 get_name 该叫 name、错误类型没实现 std::error::Error。
tagline_en: Before you publish, it walks every pub item against C-CASE, C-GETTER, C-COMMON-TRAITS and more — down to whether.
desc_en: Design Rust library APIs that follow the Rust API Guidelines — naming (C-CASE, C-CONV, C-GETTER), interop traits (C-COMMON-TRAITS, C-CONVERT, C-ITER, C-SERDE), predictability (C-INTUITIVE, C-CONST), flexibility (C-GENERIC, C-NEWTYPE, C-EXT), type safety (C-BOOL, C-NONZERO, C-WRAPPER, C-STR), dependability (C-PANIC, C-UNWRAP), debuggability (C-DEBUG), and future-proofing (C-SEALED, C-STRUCT-FIELD,
why_zh: 不是泛泛的 lint，而是把每条 guideline 的编号和你的具体签名对上，告诉你改哪个标识符。
why_en: Not a vague lint: it maps each guideline ID to your exact signature and says which identifier to rename, which impl to add.
limit_zh: 只管公开 API 表面，不查内部实现、性能或 unsafe 正确性。
limit_en: Covers public API surface only — not internals, perf, or unsafe soundness; macro-generated and #[doc(hidden)] items are skipped, and generic-bound.
title_en: Audit your Rust public API against the API Guidelines.
